dedupe_keys.name: tractorcan gps field operation load cycles and gnss traces

description: This collection records GNSS positions and J1939 or ISOBUS operating signals from five tractors rated between seventy-seven and 240 kilowatts on Technical University of Munich farms. The researchers enrich measurements with tractor and implement information to support machinery electrification and agricultural load-cycle modelling. Zenodo provides five compressed CSV collections free under CC BY 4.0, with a separate example plotting notebook. Coverage is the 2024 agricultural season in southern Germany; actual recording times are hidden for anonymisation. The deposit reports 1,245 operating hours while the article reports 862 hours, an unresolved discrepancy and a limitation for aggregate comparisons. A reviewer-assessed use is estimating agricultural electricity demand and storage requirements from field duty cycles. model-system-advisor-model-sam is a related energy-storage modelling resource, without verified load conversion. No tractor measurements, plotting notebook or electrification calculation was downloaded or executed.
name: TractorCAN-GPS field-operation load cycles and GNSS traces
